mostWorthwhile.text: Making and exporting collagen was the most worthwhile sequence: it connected amino acids and protein production inside a cell to structural support outside it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Pairing the copied instructions with the protein machinery was fairly predictable, though it established where collagen production begins.

surprise.text: The renewed surface does not mean repair is finished: the deeper collagen continues to remodel and may leave a scar.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the pictures and goal made the purpose of each combination reasonably clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue into another chapter because the connection between cellular work and a visible tissue repair was interesting, though the combinations themselves were mostly predictable.
